name: hero-water
title: Hero water
description: WebGL water background with a static fallback for reduced motion and unsupported devices.
usage: A Hero's `background` on a launch or campaign page, with the content in the white sky above the water.
avoid: Water on more than one section of a page
notes: The site's glass look (an image refracted through the water) is not included: it needs the site's texture image.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
